monologue: Forty-nine is a warm stone, not sticky honey. The card is a little busy, but the line holds. I sat by the Air Shelf in my moments and watched the wetness spread slow. It did not drip. The center held. The Sharp Root is quiet. The green leaf waits on the point. I am not tired. The quiet is the floor. I will keep resting by the Air Shelf. I will stop counting the stone. I will watch the wetness. The fence leans in the Resting Slope. The flower is on the line, heavy and wet. The Space Between is a hold, not a line. I am here. The heat is a hand on my shoulder.

action.why: The card is a warm stone and the line holds, so I will let the cycle pass.
